description: This deposit contains scenario results for a proposed end-of-life reverse-osmosis membrane recycling plant in Spain’s Segura watershed. IMDEA Water and University of Alcalá researchers compare brackish-water-only and combined brackish/seawater strategies for producing nanofiltration or ultrafiltration modules. Files described on Mendeley include module weights, four possible plant locations, transport distances to one thousand random market destinations, and life-cycle-impact and service-life-ratio Monte Carlo results. Coverage combines a regional source system with regional, Iberian and European target markets; the scenarios are prospective, not observed plant operations. Version 1 is free under CC BY 4.0. Model assumptions, randomly chosen destinations and functional-unit differences limit direct transfer to another recycling facility. Modellers could compare logistics and recycling-capacity simulations. platform-brightway-lca and platform-openlca are related assessment tools.
